name: observatory-experiments-v1
status: pre-registered before any A/B/C run; thresholds below are not to be changed after results are seen
data_policy: SYNTHETIC only (Mode A). No historical evaluation data, no BTC/ETH holdout, no SOL/BNB reserve. No LLM calls.

base_profile.name: realistic_fundamental
base_profile.why: volatility diagnosis v1: the default fundamental alone is 3.5-4x too volatile at 1 min; this profile removes that exogenous excess so endogenous effects are visible. SimConfig defaults are NOT changed.

common.pairing: every treatment is paired with the same seed in its control; differences are treatment - control; 95% percentile-bootstrap CI over seeds (n=4: low power, CIs are wide by construction)
common.detector_constants: src/evolutionx/observatory/metrics.py module constants (ACTIVE_STANCE 0.05, WITHDRAWAL_FRAC 0.5, CASCADE_GAP_MS 60000, SECONDARY_WINDOW_MS 300000, REGIME_WIN_MIN 10, REGIME_HIGH 1.5, REGIME_MIN_DWELL_MIN 5, PANIC_WINDOW_MS 60000)

labels.interaction-dependent: the metric changes when an interaction channel is removed (paired CI excludes 0) while the population is unchanged
labels.programmed/common-input: the metric is reproduced without the interaction channel, i.e. explained by individual rules reacting to shared inputs
labels.association: observed together but no ablation isolates the channel; no causal claim

A_stable.question: Does the 256-agent market stay stable without shocks, and which collective properties need interaction?

HA1-anchoring.prediction: full: max |mid/fundamental - 1| < 3% in every seed and no circuit-breaker halt

HA2-amplification-replicates.prediction: full mid 1m std / fundamental 1m std > 1.3 (mean over seeds), replicating diagnosis v2 on fresh seeds

HA3-social-amplification.prediction: paired diff (full - no_social) in mid 1m std > 0 with CI excluding 0

HA4-herding-needs-interaction.prediction: herding index mean: full - no_social > 0 with CI excluding 0
HA4-herding-needs-interaction.refuted_if: CI includes 0 -> herding is explained by common price input (programmed)

HA5-stylized-facts-need-strategic-agents.prediction: full has higher |r| ACF(1) and excess kurtosis than zero_intelligence (paired)
HA5-stylized-facts-need-strategic-agents.refuted_if: both paired diffs have CI including 0

B_liquidity_crisis.question: What happens to spread, depth, volatility and impact when market makers withdraw, and do the remaining makers withdraw too?
B_liquidity_crisis.control: same seed, shock disarmed (identical to full A condition)
B_liquidity_crisis.window: [900 s, 1200 s) for crisis; [1200 s, 1500 s) for recovery

HB1-spread.prediction: median spread rises vs control, and more at f=0.9 than f=0.5

HB2-depth.prediction: median depth (10 levels, venue 0) falls vs control at f=0.9

HB3-volatility.prediction: 1m mid return std inside the window rises vs control at f=0.9

HB4-impact.prediction: price move per BTC of aggressive flow (sum |r_1m| / sum |flow_1m|) rises at f=0.9

HB5-recovery.prediction: in the recovery window median spread is within 20% of control (mean over seeds)

HB6-withdrawal-contagion.prediction: NONE (open question): remaining (not withdrawn) makers change their near-mid depth vs the same makers in control
HB6-withdrawal-contagion.report: paired diff with CI; label interaction-dependent if CI excludes 0

C_liquidation_cascade.question: Does a forced whale liquidation cascade into other accounts, and does the presence of leveraged agents amplify it?
C_liquidation_cascade.control: same seed and population with the whale shock disarmed (the whale still builds its position before 900 s)

HC1-secondary-liquidations.prediction: with leveraged present and 1000 BTC, armed - disarmed liquidations of non-external accounts in [900, 1200) s > 0 in at least 3 of 4 seeds

HC2-leverage-amplifies-drop.prediction: (armed - disarmed) price drop to the window minimum is larger with leveraged present than absent at 1000 BTC (paired by seed)
HC2-leverage-amplifies-drop.refuted_if: CI of the difference of differences includes 0 -> no evidence of amplification

HC3-dose.prediction: the armed-disarmed drop is larger at 1000 BTC than at 250 BTC with leveraged present

C_liquidation_cascade.caveat: removing leveraged agents changes N (256 -> 240); the armed-disarmed difference within each population controls for the baseline shift, not for the changed depth/flow mix

stopping_rule: one run per (condition, seed). No re-runs with new seeds or changed thresholds to rescue a hypothesis; any further runs are a new, separately registered version.

amendment_1.before_results: written before any registered A/B/C run; only a 2-seed 420 s code smoke test (different durations, not reported) had been executed
amendment_1.change: with n=4 a percentile bootstrap CI is bounded by the min/max paired difference and is close to a sign test. For CI-based hypotheses the verdict is: 'supported' if BOTH the bootstrap CI and the t-interval exclude 0 in the predicted direction; 'weak (bootstrap only)' if only the bootstrap CI does; 'not supported' otherwise ('refuted' is reserved for threshold hypotheses HA1, HA2, HB5, HC1, where the registered threshold is crossed in the wrong direction).
amendment_1.reason: more conservative than the original rule; avoids presenting 4/4 same-sign seeds as a 95% result
